name: sos2ss
expr: [A, B, C, D] = sos2ss(sos); e = sort(real(eig(A)));
comment: Sig [A,B,C,D]=sos2ss(sos): SOS cascade -> state-space realization. A is 2x2 for one biquad. The realization (A,B,C) is basis-dependent, so pin the ORDER-INVARIANT eigenvalues of A (= filter poles, roots of [1 -0.3 0.02] = 0.1, 0.2) and the feedthrough D=1 (= b0/a0).
